checks.database_version: Observation only; genuine identity, schema, grants, controlled-account, engine and unsafe-object checks preserved.
checks.native_confinement: No Rust confinement or service security behavior changed.
checks.one_shot_and_cleanup: Exclusive dispatch markers, original operation bounds, exact born-process handling and exact-owned cleanup preserved.
checks.positive_and_negative_integration: Actual current compiler receipt and binary bytes exercised through binder, producer, consumer and cleanup; failed admission and changed identity/profile refuse. Native observations in local tests are explicitly fixtures.
checks.public_preservation: No public mail service lifecycle/configuration changes or actual operator account changes added.
checks.source_identity: Binder verifies current signed source and compiler manifest; producer and consumer agree on actual current binary hashes and compiler receipt.

limits: Source review is distinct from native startup evidence.
Local integration fixtures do not establish native product acceptance.
No full T03 journey or production readiness claim.

native_result_reference.final_disposition: Controlled runtime effects and both historical/current staging directory pairs disposed; compiler artifacts retained for reuse.
native_result_reference.timing_limit: Paired socket publication time is measured; ParentPrepare and ParentSeal completion is separately established by handled EOF connections, without individual phase timestamps.

scope: MariaDB prerequisite semantics, current-source startup integration, exact-owned cleanup and focused tests

separate_independent_build_source_review.note: Build implementation authored by this source reviewer was independently reviewed by another agent.
